description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'RowBasedKeyValueBatch' used in Apache Spark for storing key-value pairs in contiguous memory, with support for fixed-length and variable-length data types, memory management, and iteration over stored entries.

classes.name: RowBasedKeyValueBatch
classes.description: An abstract class for batching key-value pairs in contiguous memory, supporting fixed and variable length data types, with memory management and iteration capabilities.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Factory method to allocate a RowBasedKeyValueBatch instance based on schema fixed-length property.

methods.name: numRows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows stored in the batch.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the memory page.

methods.name: appendRow
methods.description: Abstract method to append a key-value pair into the batch.

methods.name: getKeyRow
methods.description: Retrieves the key row at a specified index.

methods.name: getValueRow
methods.description: Retrieves the value row at a specified index, reusing metadata from the key.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve value row based on key row index.

methods.name: rowIterator
methods.description: Abstract method to get an iterator over all key-value pairs.
